name: Momoe Maria
source:
The head coach of the baseball team. The team nicknames her "Momokan", short for "Momoe-kantoku" (Coach Momoe), and develop a respect for her, though they often find her intimidating.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Windup!#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
